title: The 3 Agent Setup I use in Claude Code
description:
Your AI isn't the problem.

It's grading its own homework.

One agent plans, builds, and reviews.

So it never catches itself.

One bad call spreads everywhere.

Here's what changed for me.

Split the job into roles.

Someone reads the code.

Someone writes the plan.

Someone tests against it.

Each gets its own context.

It's like a builder inspecting his own house.

You want someone else walking through.

Errors surface in minutes.

Not three features later.

Give each agent one job.

#claudecode #aiagents #subagents #frontend #backend
